line.relation_role: discovery seed only; may contain nested route relations
line.physical_model_rule: Two independent physical centerlines must be extracted from OSM/project ways. Track B must never be produced by a constant lateral offset from Track A.

coordinate_policy.horizontal: OSM WGS84 may be transformed to engineering CRS for a plan approximation, but is not an engineering survey.
coordinate_policy.vertical: Do not invent Z. z_ugr_m remains null until survey/profile evidence is attached.
coordinate_policy.switch_xy: Do not use station coordinates as switch coordinates; keep null until an actual physical way/node or drawing is resolved.

notes: Current Moscow Transport independently states that trains leave Krasnaya Presnya depot onto the first track and that first-track travel is clockwise.
Historical metro track literature explicitly calls the clockwise inner track the first track.
Current Moscow Transport states that depot trains entering the second track take their first passengers at Krasnopresnenskaya, consistent with counterclockwise travel.
This track is not a generated offset of Track A.

inputs: current OSM relation/full export for relation 1462012 and any nested route relations
or current Moscow PBF member-way export
forbidden_automation: choosing one branch at a SWITCH_NODE
merging Track A and Track B
classifying a branch as depot/crossover from geometry alone
creating Track B by lateral offset
classification_after_extraction: match two closed main cycles to the independently sourced clockwise/counterclockwise station sequences
annotate remaining edges from researched junction semantics
retain unclassified edges rather than guessing

confirmed: trains can leave depot onto Track A/first track and Track B/second track
Belorusskaya has a 3-switch turnback siding continuing to depot connection
Krasnopresnenskaya has 3 turnouts and one turnback/storage track continuing to depot connection
confirmed_track_development_systems.crossover_between_main_tracks: multi-switch turnback/depot system confirmed; exact direct main-to-main crossover semantics and switch-node decomposition remain unresolved

current_normative_constraint.value: a line is to be connected to its own depot by a two-track connecting branch
current_normative_constraint.applicability: current design rule; not proof that every historical physical segment at Krasnaya Presnya is a single two-track tunnel

confirmed_track_development_systems.actual_branch_arrangement_status: UNRESOLVED; current sources prove service access to both Line-5 directions but do not yet resolve every physical branch edge/tunnel shell

selected_first_junction.reason: Actual Koltsevaya junction has a published construction photograph/caption plus a track-development schematic and station operating description.
selected_first_junction.incoming_orientation: toward Krasnopresnenskaya in the counterclockwise direction
selected_first_junction.diverging_outgoing: left toward turnback siding and the Krasnaya Presnya depot connection system
selected_first_junction.branch_system_kind: multi-switch turnback/depot system, not an isolated turnout
selected_first_junction.crossover_between_main_tracks: multi-switch turnback/depot system is source-backed; an exact direct main-to-main crossover decomposition is not asserted until the physical OSM/project graph is resolved

station_pk_context.meaning: Belorusskaya station reference only; NOT switch chainage

selected_first_junction.branch_end_model: cut before depot; exact cut XY unresolved

global_unknowns: exact OSM way IDs and node IDs for the two main physical cycles until current relation/full or PBF bytes are acquired
as-built inter-tunnel axis spacing by chainage
local relative Z of the two running tunnels
line-wide lining type assignment by physical edge
exact engineering XY/Z of Line-5 switch nodes
exact installed turnout project/model at the selected Belorusskaya depot junction

TRACK_EDGE.rule: one physical rail path with its own centerline; never synthesized by offsetting another TRACK_EDGE

SWITCH_NODE.null_policy: fields may remain null until source-backed annotation resolves them; graph extractor supplies only node/degree/OSM XY

CROSSOVER.rule: semantic object added only after source-backed topology annotation; not inferred from proximity

BRANCH_EDGE.rule: role must come from researched topology, never from geometric convenience

END_NODE.rule: PCG may terminate a depot/service branch here without modelling the depot
